167: lint-shell: ## 🐚 Lint shell scripts with shellcheck
168: 	$(call print_section,"Shell Script Linting")
169: 	@SHELL_FILES=$$(find . -name "*.sh" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.history/*"); \
170: 	if [ -n "$$SHELL_FILES" ]; then \
171: 		echo "$$SHELL_FILES" | xargs shellcheck -e SC1091 -e SC2034 -e SC2154 || \
172: 			($(call print_error,"Shell script linting failed") && exit 1); \
173: 		$(call print_success,"Shell script linting passed"); \
174: 	else \
175: 		echo "ℹ️  No shell scripts found to lint"; \
176: 	fi

178: lint-docker: ## 🐳 Lint Dockerfiles with hadolint
179: 	$(call print_section,"Dockerfile Linting")
180: 	@DOCKER_FILES=$$(find . -name "Dockerfile" -o -name "*.dockerfile" | grep -v node_modules | grep -v .git); \
181: 	if [ -n "$$DOCKER_FILES" ]; then \
182: 		echo "$$DOCKER_FILES" | xargs docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint:latest \
183: 			--ignore DL3008 --ignore DL3009 --ignore DL3015 || \
184: 			($(call print_error,"Dockerfile linting failed") && exit 1); \
185: 		$(call print_success,"Dockerfile linting passed"); \
186: 	else \
187: 		echo "ℹ️  No Dockerfiles found to lint"; \
188: 	fi

190: lint-json: ## 📋 Validate JSON files
191: 	$(call print_section,"JSON Validation")
192: 	@JSON_FILES=$$(find . -name "*.json" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.history/*"); \
193: 	FAILED=false; \
194: 	for file in $$JSON_FILES; do \
195: 		if ! python3 -m json.tool "$$file" > /dev/null 2>&1; then \
196: 			$(call print_error,"Invalid JSON: $$file"); \
197: 			FAILED=true; \
198: 		else \
199: 			echo "✅ Valid JSON: $$file"; \
200: 		fi; \
201: 	done; \
202: 	if [ "$$FAILED" = true ]; then \
203: 		exit 1; \
204: 	fi
205: 	@$(call print_success,"JSON validation passed")
